violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer and Cuisinart ) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Items are to be cleaned and sanitized before use. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Eggs were observed held at 59-64 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for shell eggs must be held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Moldy pork was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the service line area. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026
Single service items observed stored on the floor in the kitchen. Single service items must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026
The dishwasher thermometer was not in good repair, nonfunctional during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris: refrigerator hot hold unit small freezer panini press. The non-food contact surfaces of 2 portable fans have an accumulation of dust. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026
Management's plan for assessing, monitoring, and controlling foodborne disease hazards is inadequate. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025
Toilet rooms are lacking proper signage. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

Unclean cutting boards observed on top of open food containers on the salad bar, in contact with the food below. Open food containers observed stacked, directly in contact with food below. Food must be protected from contamination by packaging, covered containers, or wrapping. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Food contact surfaces of cutting boards used as lids on salad bar, and food containers about to be used by staff were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Yogurt observed held at 51 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chicken was placed hot in the refrigerator stacked greater than four inches deep. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Lettuce was not washed before being cut. Plant foods must be thoroughly washed in water to remove soil and other contaminants before they are cut. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Utensils observed stored on unclean surfaces (beneath panini press, and under a tray on front service line) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025
Utensils observed stored in unclean drawer containing debris, along. with unclean items. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in areas of the kitchen, salad bar, shelves, and front service line. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

The open refrigerator case was not in good repair, not holding food at 41 degrees or below.Foods requiring refrigeration are not to be stored in it until it is functioning properly. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the utensil storage drawers including handles, and food storage containers, have an accumulation of food residue, old paper & adhesive, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025
The walls have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024

Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (sauce) in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024

Thermometers are lacking in the cold drawer unit. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2024

Sandwiches and muffins packaged in the food establishment are lacking complete labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the panini press has an accumulation of black and brown residue. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2024
